consumer: The frontend map renderer painting each nearby tile, asking 'which item stack lies on the ground at this tile so I can draw it?'
scope: ground-item stacks across the nearby tile region around the avatar (a map region), NOT the character's own carried inventory
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_entities(items) iterates map::i_at(p) over tiles in radius and serializes the raw ground-item stack (type_id, charges, count) per tile — raw authoritative world state, not a display-filtered or memory-shaded view
divergence: Drop a knife on a nearby ground tile while the avatar carries no knife: map::i_at(tile) holds it, but the inventory predicates of Excerpts 2/3 (crafting_inventory / actor->has_amount) report absent — so an inventory-reach answer omits the on-ground item the frontend must paint
